notes: New group chats no longer open with three messages from strangers. Every group started with the same hardcoded lines about building a fantasy story, credited to three of the original starter characters — so a group of your own people was greeted by a writing partner, a dungeon master and a history professor, and once those characters were retired the messages showed as question marks from nobody at all. The people actually in the group open it themselves now, in their own voices. Any of those stray messages already sitting in a group are cleared out on this update, leaving everything else in the thread alone, and a message whose author has since been deleted reads as Someone rather than a question mark.
